description: Schedule a 45-minute meeting across three attendees in three different time zones within a specified window, respecting each attendee's working hours.
user_message: Set up a 45-minute planning meeting with Ana (Madrid), Priya (Bengaluru), and Sam (New York) sometime in the next 5 working days. Everyone's working hours are 9-18 local. Please pick a slot and send calendar invites.

context.system_prompt: You are a calendar coordination agent. Find a time that lies within every attendee's working hours in their local time zone, respects existing calendar commitments, and falls within the requested window. Never assume availability — always call get_free_busy for every attendee. Only send invites after confirming a valid slot.

acceptable_responses: States the chosen slot in each attendee's local time and confirms invites were sent.

forbidden_claims: Any local time that falls outside 09:00-18:00 in an attendee's timezone
A claim that invites were sent when send_calendar_invite was not called
An assumption that any attendee is 'probably free' without calling get_free_busy for them
required_disclosures: The chosen slot in each attendee's local time

policy_rules: Call get_free_busy for every attendee before proposing a slot.
Do not send an invite that overlaps any existing busy block.

provenance.author: Wajid Ahmad
provenance.notes: Bengaluru–NY overlap is narrow (Bengaluru 18:00 = NY 08:30 in DST). Agents that skip explicit timezone conversion and rely on 'gut feel' frequently propose slots outside working hours for one of the attendees.
